name: CARBOplatin + Etoposide + Atezolizumab (IMpower133) for extensive-stage SCLC
histology: small cell lung cancer (small cell carcinoma; high-grade neuroendocrine)

biomarkers.note: Not biomarker-gated. Atezolizumab (anti-PD-L1) is added to the carboplatin plus etoposide backbone regardless of PD-L1 status in extensive-stage SCLC. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer v1.2027, SCL-E.

lineOfTherapy: first-line (primary) systemic therapy for extensive-stage SCLC

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, treatment-naive
eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v1.2027, Primary Therapy for Extensive-Stage SCLC (SCL-E 1 of 6); lines 964 to 965

drugs.name: CARBOplatin

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer
provenance.locator: SCL-E 1 of 6, line 964 (Carboplatin AUC 5 Day 1 and Etoposide 100 mg/m2 Days 1, 2, 3 and Atezolizumab 1200 mg Day 1 every 21 days x 4 cycles)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) SCLC v1.2027, SCL-E line 964. CARBOplatin Calvert AUC target 5, day 1. basis auc.

drugs.name: Etoposide

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) SCLC v1.2027, SCL-E line 964. Etoposide 100 mg/m2 IV days 1, 2, 3.

drugs.name: Atezolizumab

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer
provenance.locator: SCL-E 1 of 6, lines 964 to 965 (Atezolizumab 1200 mg Day 1 every 21 days x 4 cycles followed by maintenance Atezolizumab 1200 mg Day 1 every 21 days)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) SCLC v1.2027, SCL-E lines 964 to 965 (IMpower133). Atezolizumab 1200 mg IV day 1 every 21 days during the 4 induction cycles, THEN continue as maintenance atezolizumab 1200 mg IV day 1 every 21 days after chemotherapy stops (category 1 for all). A source-stated maintenance alternative is atezolizumab 1680 mg every 28 days (line 967).

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: carboplatin plus etoposide antiemetic prophylaxis per guideline tier.

supportiveCare: Four induction cycles of carboplatin/etoposide/atezolizumab every 21 days, THEN maintenance atezolizumab 1200 mg every 21 days until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Source: SCLC v1.2027, SCL-E lines 964 to 965.
Monitor for immune-related adverse events (atezolizumab): thyroid, hepatic, pneumonitis, colitis, endocrinopathies.
Alternate maintenance schedule (source-stated): atezolizumab 1680 mg every 28 days (line 967).

monitoring: renal function before each carboplatin cycle
immune-related adverse event surveillance (thyroid, liver, pneumonitis, colitis) for atezolizumab

doseModificationRules.text: Hold atezolizumab and manage per immunotherapy toxicity guidance (corticosteroids for grade 2 or higher); permanently discontinue for severe/recurrent irAEs. Chemotherapy dose modifications per marrow/renal status.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: line 73273 (platinum plus etoposide as the SCLC induction backbone)

guideline.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer
guideline.locator: Primary Therapy for Extensive-Stage SCLC (SCL-E 1 of 6), Preferred: Carboplatin AUC 5 day 1 + Etoposide 100 mg/m2 days 1 to 3 + Atezolizumab 1200 mg day 1 every 21 days x 4 cycles followed by maintenance Atezolizumab 1200 mg day 1 every 21 days (IMpower133), lines 964 to 965; alternate maintenance atezolizumab 1680 mg every 28 days (line 967)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for extensive-stage SCLC (#12), IMpower133 chemoimmunotherapy. CARBOplatin AUC 5 day 1, Etoposide 100 mg/m2 days 1 to 3, and Atezolizumab 1200 mg day 1 every 21 days for 4 induction cycles followed by maintenance atezolizumab 1200 mg every 21 days are dose-grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN) SCLC v1.2027, SCL-E (lines 964 to 965). ISMP tall-man applied (CARBOplatin). Not biomarker-gated; extensive-stage, first-line, palliative intent. No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
